verdict.rationale: Obsidian exposes a Vault API for programmatically reading/writing files and folders, and Bases lets you build database-like views over many notes, which could underpin bulk operations, but there is no documented first-party bulk-edit/bulk-action feature or evidence of an AI agent performing multi-item batch operations. missing for 10: native bulk operation UI/API, explicit agent/automation example performing batch actions across notes, independent confirmation of scale/performance.
